"""Record the actual resumed tool cell; create review-only pixel crops."""
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v9-same-owner-continuation.json'
assert not target.exists()
spec=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v9-preflight-continuation-spec-20261025.json'
launcher=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v9-preflight-continuation-20261025.js'
reconciliation=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261025-v9-preflight-stdout-reconciliation.json'
assert file_sha256(reconciliation)=='005d4c1f4a53653a660f1fdda9f634093cfccd8ec227b0e566160a921504c3e1'
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'recorded_at_utc':utc_now(),'actual_functions_cell_id':'814','scope':'Actual functions exec launch returned cell 814 and notified exact source19d59ea8 builtin dispatch. Same existing owner, original deadline and previous request count retained. This receipt is not an image success or review. Original failed715 invocation never reached image tool; immutable reconciliation preserves all boundaries.','reconciliation':reconciliation.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'reconciliation_sha256':file_sha256(reconciliation),'continuation_spec':read_json(spec),'continuation_spec_sha256':file_sha256(spec),'exact_launched_source':launcher.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'launcher_sha256':file_sha256(launcher),'recorder_source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
folder=ROOT/'runtime/root-review-slot-b/rollingb109';proof=read_json(folder/'verified-binding.json');target=folder/'actual-detail-crops.json';assert not target.exists()
specs=[(1,'generated_fullsize_image','generated_fullsize_sha256',[340,420,800,850],'1-nose-review-only.png'),(2,'generated_fullsize_image','generated_fullsize_sha256',[740,310,980,730],'2-temple-review-only.png'),(2,'source_nearest4','source_nearest4_sha256',[300,130,610,480],'2-source-temple-review-only.png'),(4,'generated_fullsize_image','generated_fullsize_sha256',[340,430,820,900],'4-nose-review-only.png')]
rows=[]
for index,field,digest_field,box,name in specs:
 e=next(e for e in proof['entries'] if e['index']==index);p=ROOT/e[field];assert file_sha256(p)==e[digest_field]
 path=folder/name;assert not path.exists()
 with Image.open(p) as im:im.crop(box).save(path)
 rows.append({'index':index,'input':p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'input_sha256':file_sha256(p),'crop_box':box,'review_only_output':path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'review_only_output_sha256':file_sha256(path),'scope':'Actual pixel crop only; no production image edit, no approval.'})
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'created_at_utc':utc_now(),'crops':rows,'source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'actual_cell_recorded':'814','metadata':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'crops':rows},ensure_ascii=True),flush=True)

"""Count a normally completed root b group and preserve its exact evidence."""
import json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
tag=sys.argv[1];assert re.fullmatch(r'rollingb[0-9]+',tag)
receipt=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-slot-completions/{tag}.json';done=read_json(receipt)
assert done['status']=='reviewed_and_staged' and done['machine_id']==machine_id()
report=ROOT/done['report'];body=read_json(report);assert file_sha256(report)==done['report_sha256']
slot=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json');assert slot['status']=='available' and slot['last_report']==done['report']
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v9-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path);assert phase['current_tag']==tag and phase['current_kind']=='portrait' and phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups']
target=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-handovers/20261025-root-{tag}.json';assert not target.exists()
proof=ROOT/f'runtime/root-review-slot-b/{tag}/verified-binding.json';config=ROOT/done['config']
phase['completed_groups']+=1;phase.update(current_tag=None,current_kind=None,updated_at_utc=utc_now())
phase.setdefault('completed',[]).append({'tag':tag,'report':done['report'],'report_sha256':file_sha256(report),'completed_at_utc':done['completed_at_utc']})
detail=proof.parent/'actual-detail-crops.json'
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'operator':'Codex root in existing b slot; b agent stopped','report':done['report'],'report_sha256':file_sha256(report),'counts':body['counts'],'slot_completion':receipt.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'slot_completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'actual_review_config':read_json(config),'config_sha256':file_sha256(config),'independent_ordered_builtin_binding':read_json(proof),'binding_proof_sha256':file_sha256(proof),'targeted_actual_pixel_details':read_json(detail) if detail.exists() else [],'finite_phase_after_completion':phase,'finalizer_source':{'path':Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(Path(__file__)),'source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')},'scope':'Actual root observations/decisions, no automatic approval or new slot. Stage/global/complete already succeeded once. Sole running builtin producer applies decisions between imports; all original/raw PNGs remain unchanged.'})
write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'counts':body['counts'],'completed_groups':phase['completed_groups'],'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()},ensure_ascii=True))
